optimizedPipelines.label: full-release-like
optimizedPipelines.$commentByteIdentical: MEASURED 2026-08-15 — optimized image BYTE-IDENTICAL to the baseline on: arm64:elf64-aarch64-linux-exec, x86_64:elf64-x86_64-linux-exec, x86_64:pe64-x86_64-windows-exec. Legs actually run: windows/pe64-x86_64 and linux/elf64 (x86_64 + aarch64 under qemu); the darwin/macho64 leg was NOT run. Where the image is identical the arm's exit-code/stdout comparison is x==x and cannot fail. HONEST: the work this example pins happens behind an EXTERN call the pipeline cannot see through, so no pass has a body to transform on this side of the call. Every step is an extern libc call (`memcpy`, `memcmp`, `memchr`, `memset`, `memmove`). Deliberately NOT given "mustDifferFromBaseline" — an honest no-op, not a missed opt-in.
